dataset.name: UN DESA · International migrant stock
dataset.definition: UN DESA 2024 edition; both sexes; mid-year stock
dataset.caveat: Stocks count people residing abroad at mid-year; they are not annual migration flows.

note: Polygon color shows sums of reported incoming or outgoing corridor values, not within-country/state population density or travel paths. Missing, suppressed, unpublished, and threshold-excluded values are not zero. Unpublished corridors may be absent; reported sums are not complete totals. Modern generalized boundaries are visualization outlines, not historical borders. Color uses log(1 + value) with a per-selection maximum; compare numeric values rather than colors across sources or periods. Stocks count people residing abroad at mid-year; they are not annual migration flows.
